findings.title: Failed external execution left the GUI indexing dialog and blocked UI active.
evidence: TaskExecuteCustomCommands uses updateCustomIndexingDialog, which creates QtIndexingProgressDialog.
The original failure branch in TaskFinishParsing called only hideUnknownProgressDialog.
QtDialogView::hideUnknownProgress pops only QtUnknownProgressDialog and does not unblock the UI while other windows remain.
Bypassing finishedIndexingDialog also bypassed its Windows taskbar progress cleanup.
resolution: QtDialogView::clearDialogs clears windows, hides Windows taskbar progress and unblocks the UI in the same Qt-thread callback.
TrackingFinishDialog assertions require clearCalls == 1, unknownProgressHideCalls == 0 and finishedCalls == 0.
findings.validation_scope: Independent source review of the complete call path and added assertions. The reviewer did not build or execute the C++ test or operate a real GUI/Windows desktop.

placeholder_observation_review.origin: Root's final integration run exposed a harness assumption, then root requested this follow-up review.
placeholder_observation_review.original_failure: The first failed external run correctly discarded its candidate, leaving initialized tables in the main DB but no storage_version row. Strict read_snapshot raised Unsupported schema version: [].
production_source_basis: Project::load constructs the main PersistentStorage and calls setup.
PersistentStorage::setup calls SqliteStorage::setupMetaTable and SqliteIndexStorage::setupTables without writing an index storage version.
Project::buildIndex writes project_settings and calls updateVersion on tempStorage, the candidate.
The actual initial index shape is the twelve SCHEMA data tables plus meta, with no rows in any of the thirteen tables and only sqlite_autoindex_occurrence_1 as a non-table schema object.

resolution.accepted: schema-25 plus the actual result of unchanged read_snapshot
recognition_requirements: Read-only SQLite URI and one read transaction for placeholder inspection.
PRAGMA quick_check returns exactly ok and PRAGMA foreign_key_check is empty.
The table set is exactly SCHEMA plus meta.
The column names and order match every expected table, including meta(id,key,value).
Every table, including meta, contains zero rows.
The sole non-table sqlite_master object is the occurrence primary-key autoindex with its known identity and null SQL.
resolution.invalid_forms: All other forms go through the unchanged strict semantic reader or raise SnapshotError; unversioned nonempty data and metadata, unknown versions, drift and corrupt files are not synthesized as empty graphs.
resolution.first_run_outcome_checks: Fresh success cases require schema-25. Fresh failure cases require absent or uninitialized-empty, so an accepted failed candidate is rejected.
resolution.preservation_guard: The seed must be a real nonempty snapshot containing the authored explicit function and an indexed file. The failed update must equal that seed. None from an absent/placeholder DB cannot equal it.

placeholder_observation_review.result: Independently reviewed and checked with nine in-memory observations using all thirteen CREATE TABLE statements extracted from production source. No blocker found.
placeholder_observation_review.structural_limit: Placeholder recognition checks the declared table/column observation shape, known non-table objects, emptiness and SQLite integrity. It does not claim byte-for-byte DDL equivalence or a general proof of every storage constraint.

implementation_assessments.subject: Shared outcomes and the worker barrier
implementation_assessments.conclusion: ExternalIndexerRunState serializes begin, settle and snapshot under its mutex. TaskExecuteCustomCommands joins all workers before consulting failures and merging/finalizing. A later success cannot decrement or erase failed.

implementation_assessments.subject: Task completion and candidate discard
implementation_assessments.conclusion: External failure remains separate from Task::STATE_FAILURE, so the sequence reaches TaskFinishParsing, storage disposition and terminal notification. Failed output is not offered through the keep/discard UI and is not postprocessed or merged.

implementation_assessments.subject: Queue ordering
implementation_assessments.conclusion: Task::dispatch appends through TaskScheduler::pushTask on the same app scheduler. A running non-background disposition task completes before the next task is processed. The terminal task queued after disposition cannot overtake it in the reviewed ordinary completion path.
implementation_assessments.evidence_type: source review of Task, TaskScheduler, TaskGroupSequence and Project

implementation_assessments.subject: CLI exit
implementation_assessments.conclusion: MessageIndexingFinished carries the outcome to MessageQuitApplication. QtCoreApplication copies the exit value and invokes QCoreApplication::exit through a queued Qt-thread callback. Existing message constructors retain exit code zero by default.

implementation_assessments.subject: Successful behavior and model scope
implementation_assessments.conclusion: A zero exit without transport error remains process success, including stderr or no graph writes. Parser diagnostics and graph completeness remain separate. ExternalIndexing models bounded safety with the join/barrier and one-settle-per-command preconditions; it is not an automatic C++ refinement proof or a liveness/OS model.

exact_successful_probe.command:
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .pixi/envs/default/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import ast,json,re,sqlite3,sys
from unittest.mock import patch
sys.path.insert(0,'tests/external_indexer')
import harness
import test_external_indexer as tests
storage=Path('src/lib/data/storage/sqlite/SqliteStorage.cpp').read_text()
index=Path('src/lib/data/storage/sqlite/SqliteIndexStorage.cpp').read_text()
blocks=[storage.split('void SqliteStorage::setupMetaTable()',1)[1].split('void SqliteStorage::clearMetaTable()',1)[0],index.split('void SqliteIndexStorage::setupTables()',1)[1].split('void SqliteIndexStorage::setupPrecompiledStatements()',1)[0]]
statement_pattern=r'm_database\.execDML\(\s*((?:"(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"\s*)+)\);'
literal_pattern=r'"(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"'
ddl=[''.join(ast.literal_eval(s) for s in re.findall(literal_pattern,match)) for block in blocks for match in re.findall(statement_pattern,block)]
assert len(ddl)==13,len(ddl)
class MemoryPath(type(Path())):
 def exists(self):return True
 def is_file(self):return True
 def resolve(self,*args,**kwargs):return self
 def as_uri(self):return 'file:///independent-placeholder-review'
real_connect=sqlite3.connect
results={}
cases={'production-empty':None,'accepted-empty':"INSERT INTO meta VALUES (1,'storage_version','25')",'unversioned-element':'INSERT INTO element VALUES (1)','unversioned-metadata':"INSERT INTO meta VALUES (1,'project','unexpected')",'unknown-version':"INSERT INTO meta VALUES (1,'storage_version','26')",'missing-column':'ALTER TABLE meta DROP COLUMN value','extra-table':'CREATE TABLE unexpected_data(id)','extra-view':'CREATE VIEW unexpected_view AS SELECT * FROM node','extra-index':'CREATE INDEX unexpected_index ON node(id)'}
for name,mutation in cases.items():
 base=real_connect(':memory:')
 for sql in ddl:base.execute(sql)
 if mutation:base.execute(mutation)
 base.commit()
 def clone(connection_string,**kwargs):
  assert connection_string.endswith('?mode=ro') and kwargs=={'uri':True}
  db=real_connect(':memory:');base.backup(db);return db
 try:
  with patch.object(harness.sqlite3,'connect',clone):
   state,snapshot=harness.read_index_observation(MemoryPath('/independent-placeholder-review'),Path.cwd())
  if name=='production-empty':assert (state,snapshot)==('uninitialized-empty',None)
  elif name=='accepted-empty':assert state=='schema-25' and snapshot is not None and snapshot['nodes']==[]
  else:raise AssertionError(f'Accepted damaged production shape: {name}')
  results[name]=state
 except harness.SnapshotError:
  assert name not in ('production-empty','accepted-empty')
  results[name]='rejected'
 finally:base.close()
for damage in ['exit-zero','count-failure','missing-receipt','wrong-mode','left-candidate','unexpected-index','accepted-failed-candidate']:
 tests.test_fault_checker_rejects_false_success(damage)
seed=json.loads(Path('build/external-indexer/baseline/preservation-serial/seed.snapshot.json').read_text())
assert seed is not None and seed['nodes'] and None!=seed
print(json.dumps({'production_ddl_statements':len(ddl),'in_memory_checks':results,'fault_checker_controls':7,'lost_accepted_index_cannot_equal_seed':None!=seed,'filesystem_writes':0},indent=2))
